description: Create an immutable redirect file at exactly the selection revision you showed the person (data.selection_revision). Before exporting, ask the person what to include: every proposal is the default, or only those at or above a confidence; say how many fall below RedirX's recommended review threshold (data.review from group_matches). Pass their answer as accept_proposals_above (0 for every proposal): each undecided proposal at or above it becomes their decision. Rejected rows are left out without asking; any other exclusion (held for review, no destination, unsafe for the format) needs allow_partial after the person agrees. Each old URL's other trailing-slash spelling is added as its own rule to the same destination unless slash_variants is false. Small files come back in data.content; every file is readable as the returned resource_uri. Save the file into the person's project yourself; download_url is for a person working without an agent. Export does not install redirects.

accept_proposals_above.description: Only with the person's answer: accept every undecided proposal at or above this confidence as their decision (0 = all). Omit to export decisions only.

format.description: wordpress is Redirection plugin CSV; cloudflare is Pages _redirects, not Bulk Redirects CSV. csv and json are generic review mappings that need adaptation before installation.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended change; retry an uncertain call with the identical input and key.

slash_variants.description: Also redirect each old URL's other trailing-slash spelling (/about-us and /about-us/).

name: export_redirects
title: Export redirects
